name: Herreruela (Spain)
description: White field with a green stripe in the lower part, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Herreruela (a stone on black and a cross of Alcántara on white).
history: Municipal flag of Herreruela; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Herreruela arms — stone and cross of Alcántara
